title: Workflows
noWorkflowSelected: Create or select a workflow to start
triggerInputDesc: Enter the message to trigger this workflow with:
generateDescription: Choose an agent, describe what you want, and it will build a previewable workflow draft first.
generateOfflineHint: The Gateway is offline, so the app will fall back to a basic draft until agent generation is available again.
generateAssistantFallback: A workflow draft is ready. You can keep refining it with follow-up instructions.
generateAgentHint: This agent is used to understand your requirement and plan the workflow.
generateConversationHint: Describe the flow you want to automate, then keep iterating with follow-up changes if needed.
generateConversationEmpty: Describe your goal, for example: "Generate a support triage workflow."
generatePlaceholder: Example: When a user mentions a refund, classify urgency first, then route to after-sales or human escalation.
generatePreviewEmpty: The generated workflow preview will appear here.
generateImportHint: Import creates a new workflow and immediately switches the editor to that draft.
generateApprovalHint: When the draft wants to add a skill or another external capability, you approve it first before the workflow can be imported.
generateImportBlocked: There are still pending approvals. Please approve or reject them before importing the workflow.
generateApprovalRetryFallback: The approval follow-up timed out. Your current draft has been kept, so please try again in a moment.
generateApprovalApproveMessage: I approve using skill "{{skillLabel}}" in node "{{nodeLabel}}". Please update the draft accordingly.
generateApprovalRejectMessage: I do not approve adding skill "{{skillLabel}}". Please replace node "{{nodeLabel}}" with a normal agent or an existing capability.
